chain.title: A frame for the first machines
chain.desc: Craft a Pity Machine Frame. The first latex and power machines use this starting frame; advanced frames come from the Dissolution Chamber later.

chain.title: Draw latex from logs
chain.desc: Place the Fluid Extractor against a supported log and collect its latex. Keep replacement logs and fluid storage available; supplying energy improves the extraction rate.

chain.title: A small energy supply
chain.desc: Burn supported solid fuel in a Pitiful Generator for the first machines. It is a starting option, and any compatible power source can support the factory as it expands.

chain.title: Wash latex into rubber
chain.desc: Supply latex, water, and energy to the Latex Processing Unit. Keep both fluid inputs supplied and leave room to extract the resulting tiny dry rubber.

chain.title: Collect the first rubber pieces
chain.desc: Gather Tiny Dry Rubber from the processing unit. Combine the pieces into Dry Rubber before smelting; this is the material bridge from tree extraction to plastic.

chain.title: A batch ready for the furnace
chain.desc: Combine Tiny Dry Rubber into Dry Rubber using the installed recipe. Keep enough processing capacity to support the plastic needed by later machines.

chain.title: Plastic for the machine room
chain.desc: Smelt Dry Rubber into Plastic. A steady plastic supply supports farming, mob processing, and the stronger machine frames.

chain.title: Replant the farm
chain.desc: Place the Plant Sower in the position shown by its working-area display. Supply seeds or saplings, power, and suitable ground before adding automatic harvesting.

chain.title: Harvest without losing the farm
chain.desc: Place and power the Plant Gatherer, then check its displayed area. Pair it with replanting and output storage for a sustainable crop or tree loop.

chain.title: Collect pink slime separately
chain.desc: Build an enclosed mob supply for the Slaughter Factory. It produces liquid meat and pink slime; keep both outputs draining so one full tank does not stop the other.

chain.title: Unlock the frame recipes
chain.desc: Supply the Dissolution Chamber with energy, the exact item ingredients, and the required fluid. Different frame tiers use different fluids, so check each recipe before filling it.

chain.title: The simple frame tier
chain.desc: Make a Simple Machine Frame in the Dissolution Chamber with latex and its item ingredients. Use it to expand the factory's available machines.

chain.title: A frame made with pink slime
chain.desc: Use liquid pink slime in the Advanced Machine Frame recipe. Keep this resource branch supplied; merely collecting a pink slime item does not fill the chamber's fluid tank.

chain.title: A farm for normal mob drops
chain.desc: Provide an enclosed mob area, power, and output handling. The Mob Crusher collects ordinary drops and essence, serving a different purpose from the Slaughter Factory.

chain.title: Power for laser extraction
chain.desc: Build Laser Drills and arrange them around a compatible laser base. Drills provide work; the base, lens, biome, and depth settings determine what a specific setup can extract.

chain.title: Choose the ore prospect
chain.desc: Connect powered Laser Drills to an Ore Laser Base. Consult the installed lens, biome, and depth recipes, then test the output before dedicating more power to the setup.

chain.title: Hold a mob for a process
chain.desc: Power a Stasis Chamber and confirm its working area before placing a target. A Wither-based ether-gas setup needs a deliberately prepared chamber and extraction line.

chain.title: Extract a selected fluid
chain.desc: Pair the Fluid Laser Base with powered drills and the conditions shown in the recipe viewer. Ether gas additionally needs the appropriate Wither arrangement and lens; it is not produced from empty space.

chain.title: An ether-gas frame
chain.desc: Produce ether gas through the configured Wither extraction setup, then use it in the Supreme Machine Frame recipe. Verify the fluid reaches the Dissolution Chamber before supplying expensive ingredients.

chain.title: Automate Wither construction
chain.desc: Give the Wither Builder the required soul sand and skulls in a prepared containment area. Construction is only one part of the farm; provide a separate defeat and drop-collection solution.

chain.title: Coordinate the mycelial generators
chain.desc: Build the Mycelial Reactor and read its operating conditions. Its large output requires the full set of distinct supporting mycelial generators to run; crafting the reactor alone does not activate that output.

chain.title: A tool with room to grow
chain.desc: Craft the Infinity Drill and build its charge and fuel supply. Its effective mining capabilities grow with its stored energy tier; check the current mode before using it near the base.

notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07 against local Minecraft 1.20.1 JAR item assets and selected recipes/manuals, with official project sources listed separately. Every authored row now has explicit prerequisites; empty lists identify intentional branch roots. The coverage section states the verified versions and remaining limits. This replaces older list-order and item-count claims.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
limits: Targets the cached 1.20.1 generation; addon soul and extra-machine systems are outside scope.
Complex Wither and mycelial operating conditions are explained but not automatically detected by item tasks.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.
